macros.name: carboncopy
macros.doc: This macro will set the \@carboncopy tag that will be used in the trailer of the letter.

macros.name: closeletter
macros.doc: Close the letter (with the closing greetings and underwriting) such that the letter can be continued if desired with attachments.

macros.name: email
macros.doc: This macro allows for the registration of contact email addresses for a letter.

macros.name: enclosed
macros.doc: This macro will set the \@enclosed tag that will be used in the trailer of the letter.

macros.name: fax
macros.doc: This macro allows for the registration of contact fax numbers for a letter.

macros.name: logo
macros.doc: This macro sets the \@logo tag that will be used to load a graphics file with that name.

macros.name: maketitle
macros.doc: The top of the letter is generated using the \maketitle command.

macros.name: mobile
macros.doc: This macro allows for the registration of contact mobile numbers for a letter.

macros.name: phone
macros.doc: This macro allows for the registration of contact phone numbers for a letter.

macros.name: returnaddress
macros.doc: This macro sets the \@returnaddress tag that will be used in the letter’s heading text (in the area of the envelope’s window).

macros.name: sender
macros.doc: This macro sets the \@sender and \@senderrole tags that will be used in the letter’s heading text.

macros.name: subject
macros.doc: This macro sets the \@subject tag that will be used in the letter’s heading text.

macros.name: to
macros.doc: This macro sets the \@to tag that will be used in the letter’s heading text (in the area of the envelope’s window).

macros.name: toaddress
macros.doc: This macro sets the \@toaddress tag that will be used in the letter’s heading text (in the area of the envelope’s window).

macros.name: toorganization
macros.doc: This macro sets the \@toorganization tag that will be used in the letter’s heading text (in the area of the envelope’s window).

macros.name: unit
macros.doc: This macro sets the \@unit tag that will be used in the letter’s heading text.
